AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to allowing the New
York state thruway authority to offer a discounted toll rate to residents of
Rockland and Westchester counties for Tappan Zee bridge crossings
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S131

SPONSOR: CARLUCCI
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the public authorities law, in relation to allowing the
New York state thruway authority to offer a discounted toll rate to
residents of Rockland and Westchester counties for Tappan Zee bridge
crossings

 
PURPOSE:

This bill will provide Rockland and Westchester residents with a
discount resident rate for Tappan Zee Bridge crossings at 60% of the
original toll.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Adds a new section 354-a to the public authorities law to
permit the Thruway authority, subject to agreements with noteholders and
bondholders, to offer a discounted toll, at 60% of the original toll, to
residents of Rockland and Westchester counties for Tappan Zee bridge
crossings.

Section 2. Effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

As the construction of the replacement for the Tappan Zee bridge moves
forward, we must keep in mind the residents of Rockland and Westchester
who will bear the burden of paying for anticipated increase in tolls.
Rockland residents currently lack a one seat mass transit option to
Manhattan and, given that many residents do not have an alternative mass
transit option, a discounted toll is warranted. The County of Rockland
currently pays more than $40 million to the MTA annually than it
receives back in services. This value gap demonstrates the importance of
the new Tappan Zee Bridge to the region and the need to address the lack
of mass transit available to residents of Rockland and Westchester coun-
ties.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2107-18: S1407/A1313 - TRANSPORTATION/corporations
2015-16: S1659A/A1487A - Transportation/Corporations, Authorities &
Commissions
2013-14: S1996-A/A1198-A - Transportation/Corporations, Authorities &
Commissions
2012: S7094/A9881 - Transportation/Corporations, Authorities & Commis-
sions

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined; there are currently commuter rates that are offered
and this legislation would have similar impact.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Allows the thruway authority to offer discounted tokens to residents of Rockland and Westchester counties for Tappan Zee bridge crossings.
